scope: Corollary 9.2 (The ordinary second Iitaka construction) of the manuscript “Logarithmic Kodaira dimension and whole-fiber variation” (preprints/Logarithmic-Kodaira-dimension-and-whole-fiber-variation-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b1b750b309e5c5a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 70. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the data of Proposition 9.1, there are a morphism q : W → U with connected fibers to a smooth projective variety U and a morphism j : U → Z with h0 = j ◦ q. The general q-fiber G satisfies κ(G, KG + B|G) = 0, G −→ g(G) is generically finite. There are smooth projective varieties T0, S and a diagram W (S ×T0 U)main S Y U U T0 (gS,q) q ρ with g = ρ ◦ gS, where ρ is birational and the map to the main product component is dominant and generically finite. The geometric generic fibers of S → T0 and U → T0 are integral, and (9.1) κ(St) = 0, κ(X) = κ(W, KW + B + M) = dim U = d + dim T0. Here t is a very general point of T0. All models use the section-preserving boundary convention of Proposition 9.1.
